#### **1. Who Said What (Sort by Date & Time)**  

- **[Onie Mgu] (Role not specified, Africa Health Research Institute) – [08/10/2024]:**  
- Reported issues with the Wheel of Fourte activity, including slow loading and error messages.  
- Provided testing details and requested investigation.  
- *Key quote:* "The activity is not responding, and it takes time to load. Also, some participants have reported that it returns an error message ‘Sorry something went wrong’."  

- **[Amin Ghaffari] (Role not specified, Avicenna Research) – [08/10/2024, 4:32 PM]:**  
- Requested additional details about the issue, including device information and scope.  
- *Key quote:* "Can you please provide me with more details? - Participants' device details (model, OS version) - How widespread is the issue?"  

- **[Onie Mgu] (Role not specified, Africa Health Research Institute) – [08/10/2024, 3:21 PM]:**  
- Confirmed the issue affects all participants and provided test device details.  
- *Key quote:* "The issue is affecting all participants. You can also check the logs no one has played on 08/10/24."  

- **[Alireza Javan] (Role not specified, Avicenna Research) – [Date not specified]:**  
- Clarified that the issue is related to web activities on Android and mentioned a 1-minute load limit implementation.  
- *Key quote:* "MO is implementing a 1-minute limit to automatically close web activities if they do not load successfully."  

- **[Ahmad Jafari] (Role not specified, Avicenna Research) – [11/10/2024, 2:41 PM]:**  
- Apologized for the delay and assured priority resolution.  
- *Key quote:* "Please rest assured that we are addressing your issue with the highest priority."  

- **[Thulile Mathenjwa] (Role not specified, Africa Health Research Institute) – [14/10/2024]:**  
- Requested an update on the unresolved issue.  
- *Key quote:* "Can you please provide an update on this issue. This issue has been going on since last week Tuesday."  

- **[Amin Ghaffari] (Role not specified, Avicenna Research) – [15/10/2024, 4:26 PM]:**  
- Informed that the root cause was found and a fix was being worked on by Amir Mohammad.  
- *Key quote:* "We reviewed your issue yesterday and found the root cause. I have assigned it to one my colleagues, Amir Mohammad."  

- **[AmirMohammad Askari] (Role not specified, Avicenna Research) – [15/10/2024, 6:04 PM]:**  
- Announced the fix was finalized and would be released shortly.  
- *Key quote:* "The fix for your issue is finalized and going through our release process."  

- **[AmirMohammad Askari] (Role not specified, Avicenna Research) – [22/10/2024, 4:48 AM]:**  
- Confirmed the bug was resolved and requested testing.  
- *Key quote:* "The bug you've mentioned is resolved now. Now the wheel of fortune activity can be opened properly."  

- **[Thulile Mathenjwa] (Role not specified, Africa Health Research Institute) – [Date not specified]:**  
- Acknowledged the resolution and requested confirmation from Onie.  
- *Key quote:* "Great work! Thanks Amir. Onie, can you please confirm if it's working on our side."
